property_summary: After calling transferOwnership with any valid newOwner, the owner() getter must return the newOwner address; the mutant always sets the owner to 0xdead instead, so for any input where newOwner is not 0xdead the mutant returns a different owner.
change_summary: Replace ownership transfer with a call to transfer to a hardcoded external address instead of newOwner, altering the resulting owner.
